zh: 正在为<color=#FFC600>{action}</color>重新绑定，当前按键：<color=#FFC600>{key}</color>\n请按任意键设置新按键\n提示：如果{key}已被其他操作使用，或者修改的按键为WASD或方向键（↑↓←→）此次更改将不会应用
en: Rebinding for <color=#FFC600>{action}</color>, current key: <color=#FFC600>{key}</color>\nPress any key to set a new binding\nTip: If {key} is already used by another action, or if the key being changed is WASD or the arrow keys (↑↓←→), this change will not be applied

zh: 我总感觉天台上有些说不上来的变化：
en: I keep feeling there are some indescribable changes on the rooftop:

zh: ·旁边的<color=#FFC600>保洁工具和除草剂</color>组合
en: · the nearby set of <color=#FFC600>cleaning tools and herbicide</color>.

zh: 重点搜索一下这些地方吧！
en: Let’s focus on searching these places!

zh: ·这趟真是惊险，险些在五楼和主任撞个正着，我决定用石头卡住铁门，要是被风刮得锁上就完了
en: · this trip was really thrilling; I almost ran right into the director on the fifth floor. I decide to wedge the iron door with a stone—if the wind blows it shut, it’s over.

zh: ·既然上来了，先跟着脚印去前面那个<color=#FFC600>告示牌</color>看看吧
en: · since I’m up here, I’ll follow the footprints to that <color=#FFC600>notice board</color> up ahead and take a look.

zh: 天台上的售货机？正好我有点渴了：
en: A vending machine on the rooftop? Just right, I’m a bit thirsty:

zh: ·<color=#FFC600>下水道</color>里那枚硬币，呃，看来得克服一下了
en: · that coin in the <color=#FFC600>storm drain</color>—uh, looks like I’ll have to get over it.

zh: ·草甸旁的<color=#FFC600>石头</color>说不定有什么
en: · the <color=#FFC600>stone</color> by the meadow might have something.

zh: ·右边的<color=#FFC600>石缝</color>里好像闪烁着银光
en: · there seems to be a silvery glint in the <color=#FFC600>stone crevice</color> on the right.

zh: 看来需要收集到三枚硬币
en: Looks like I need to collect three coins.

zh: 任务详情会显示在这里\n（点击任意处关闭当前教程）\n↓
en: Task details will be displayed here\n(Click anywhere to close the current tutorial)\n↓
I feel really bad right now:

zh: ·<color=#FFC600>草甸</color>里的铃兰种球长得怎么样了？……等等，这些草长得都差不多，我有点分不清哪棵是它了
en: · How is the lily-of-the-valley bulb in the <color=#FFC600>meadow</color> doing? ...Wait, all these grasses look so similar—I can’t quite tell which one it is.
· Oh no! There’s a morning run today.
· I really hope this is all just a dream.

zh: 重要提醒：此游戏流程约 10 分钟，暂不支持存档/读档，请确保有完整游玩的时间
en: Important Notice: This game takes about 10 minutes to complete and currently does not support saving/loading. Please ensure you have enough time to finish in one go.
